Container.Name: Ghost-Hub
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted digital-footprint cleaner. Connect your Gmail inbox with your own Google OAuth client, discover every service you have ever signed up for, check them against known breaches, find shadow profiles under your email, phone or username, and bulk-unsubscribe from newsletters. Everything is review-first -- nothing happens without your approval. Raw email is processed in memory and never stored, and your data never leaves your server. Requires a PostgreSQL container (set its address in DATABASE_URL) and a Google OAuth client (see the project README).
Early development: the app is a work in progress.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: privacy digital footprint gmail accounts breach haveibeenpwned unsubscribe newsletters shadow profiles account discovery
Container.Requires: Requires a PostgreSQL container (e.g. postgres:17). Set DATABASE_URL to point at it.
Container.Changes: ### 0.1.0 Initial scaffold. Project structure, Docker image and configuration only -- inbox scanning, dashboard, breach checks, newsletter unsubscribe and the shadow-profile scanner are still in development.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: URL you reach Ghost-Hub at. Used to build the Google OAuth redirect URI (APP_URL/api/auth/google/callback).

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the web UI login.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: 32-byte base64 key that encrypts your OAuth tokens at rest. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Losing it means reconnecting your inbox.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string for your Postgres container.

Config.Name: Google Client ID
Config.Description: From your own Google Cloud OAuth client (see docs/SETUP-GOOGLE-OAUTH.md in the project).

Config.Name: Google Client Secret
Config.Description: Secret for your Google OAuth client.

Config.Name: HIBP API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Have I Been Pwned API key for per-email breach lookups. Without it, services are matched against HIBP's free public breach list.
